metadata.case_name: YAU PO SHAN v. THE EXPRESS LIFT CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Administrative assistant (Target Insurance Co Ltd); previously receptionist
plaintiff.education_level: Form 5 graduate; enrolled in secretarial course

source: Ms Yau suffered from soft tissues injuries at her neck, low back and right ankle as a result of the Accident.
Examination revealed tenderness over neck, low back and right ankle regions.
I find it likely that Ms Yau has by trial only mild residual symptoms of pain, numbness and/or stiffness over her neck and spine that was caused by the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of low back

injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of right ankle
source: Ms Yau suffered from soft tissues injuries at her neck, low back and right ankle as a result of the Accident.
Examination revealed tenderness over neck, low back and right ankle regions.

Both the 2 Experts further agreed in their joint supplemental medical report dated 3 July 2017, and I find, that such laxity of anterior talofibular ligament of her right ankle (and instability of her right ankle) found on their joint examination in Nov 2016 (the 2016 Examination) was unrelated or not caused by the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at ankle or foot level

manifestations.description: Mild residual pain, numbness and/or stiffness over neck and spine
Laxity of anterior talofibular ligament of right ankle (instability) found on 2016 examination (unrelated to the Accident)

treatments_received: A&E treatment at Tuen Mun Hospital (treated and discharged same day)
Consultation with Dr Tio Man Kwun Peter (5 Nov 2011)
Treatment at Hong Kong Sport and Dance Injury Centre (5 occasions between 8 and 16 Nov 2011)
Consultation with Dr T. K. Tan (22 Nov 2011)
Chiropractic treatment (32 occasions from 22 Nov 2011 to 23 Apr 2012)
Consultation with Dr Julian W. Chang (20 Mar 2012)
treatments_future: stretching and strengthening exercises of the neck and back

losses.category: Loss of ability to participate in parenthood or grandparenthood
losses.description: Had to avoid carrying her first newborn baby (born in 2013) due to her injuries in the Accident, constituting loss in terms of her mother-and-child relationship and self-esteem as a responsible mother.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Impaired lifting capacity to perform strenuous activities such as lifting weight due to residual neck and back pain.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Temporarily handicapped to return to sports prior to end of April 2012 due to soft tissue injuries from the Accident.
